DunnTestOptions.altp#summary.en: Report two-sided p-values (twice the upper tail of |Z|) instead of one-sided ones. Default `false`.

DunnTestResult.P#summary.en: p-values: the upper tail of |Z|, or twice that with `altp`.

DunnTestResult.chi2#summary.en: Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared statistic (with the tie correction).

DunnTestResult.comparisons#summary.en: Labels of the comparisons, `"<label j> - <label i>"`, in the order (2,1), (3,1), (3,2), (4,1), ...

DunnTestResult.warnings#summary.en: R's warnings, each once, in R's order (an empty array when there are none).

GlhtDunnettOptions.alternative#summary.en: Alternative hypothesis for each group against the control. Default `"two.sided"`.

GlhtDunnettResult.df#summary.en: Residual degrees of freedom, N - k.

GlhtDunnettResult.estimate#summary.en: Differences of the group means from the control's.

GlhtDunnettResult.warnings#summary.en: R's warnings, each once, in R's order (an empty array when there are none).

KwAllPairsDunnTestOptions#summary.en: Options of the all-pairs Dunn test.

KwManyOneDunnTestOptions#summary.en: Options of the many-to-one Dunn test.

KwManyOneDunnTestOptions.pAdjustMethod#s.en: `"single-step"` (simultaneous normal probabilities, the default) or a `pAdjust` method.

ManyOneTestOptions.alternative#summary.en: Alternative hypothesis for each group against the control. Default `"two.sided"`.

ManyOneUTestOptions#summary.en: Options of Steel's many-to-one rank test (`manyOneUTest`).

PAdjustMethod#summary.en: Adjustment method for {@link pAdjust}, as in R's `p.adjust.methods`. `"fdr"` is an alias of `"BH"`.

PAdjustOptions.method#summary.en: Adjustment method. Default `"holm"`. Unambiguous abbreviations are accepted, as in R.

PAdjustOptions.n#summary.en:
Number of comparisons. Default: the number of non-`NaN` p-values. Must not be smaller
than that; must be an integer and at most 65536 for `"hommel"`.

PMCMRResult#summary.en: Result of the PMCMRplus tests (R's `PMCMR` objects).

PMCMRResult.colNames#summary.en: Labels of the columns (groups 1..k-1, or the control).

PMCMRResult.pAdjustMethod#summary.en: How the p-values were adjusted (`"single-step"` for the simultaneous probabilities).

PMCMRResult.pValue#summary.en: p-values, in the same layout as `statistic`.

PMCMRResult.statistic#summary.en:
Statistics as a table: for the all-pairs tests row `r` compares group `rowNames[r]` with each group
`colNames[c]` (lower triangle; `NaN` above the diagonal), for the many-to-one tests each group with the control
(one column).

PairwiseOptions#summary.en: Common options of the pairwise comparisons.

PairwiseOptions.alternative#summary.en: Alternative hypothesis for each comparison of row group against column group. Default `"two.sided"`.

PairwisePropTestOptions.correct#summary.en: Continuity correction in each two-group test. Default `true`.

PairwiseResult.pValue#summary.en:
Adjusted p-values as a lower-triangular table: row `r` compares group `rowNames[r]` with each group
`colNames[c]`; entries above the diagonal are `NaN`.

PairwiseResult.warnings#summary.en: R's warnings, each once, in R's order (an empty array when there are none).

PairwiseTTestOptions.paired#summary.en: Paired t tests (groups matched by position). Default `false`.

PairwiseTTestOptions.poolSd#summary.en: Pool the standard deviation over all groups. Default `!paired`.

PairwiseWilcoxTestOptions#summary.en: Options for {@link pairwiseWilcoxTest}: those of the comparisons themselves, as for `wilcoxTest`.

TukeyHSD#@param x.en: An array of samples (groups), or one sample with group labels `g` (then `options` comes third).

TukeyHSD#summary.en:
Tukey's honest significant differences between the group means of a one-way ANOVA (Tukey-Kramer for unequal
sizes). Equivalent to R's `TukeyHSD(aov(y ~ g))`.

TukeyHSDOptions.confLevel#summary.en: Family-wise confidence level in [0, 1] (a RangeError otherwise). Default `0.95`.

TukeyHSDResult#summary.en: Result of {@link TukeyHSD}: one entry per pair of groups, in R's order (2-1, 3-1, ..., k-1, 3-2, ...).

TukeyHSDResult.diff#summary.en: Difference of means, group i minus group j.

TukeyHSDResult.i#summary.en: The group compared (1-based position among the groups compared, i > j).

TukeyHSDResult.j#summary.en: The group it is compared with (1-based index).

TukeyHSDResult.lwr#summary.en: Lower ends of the simultaneous intervals.

TukeyHSDResult.names#summary.en:
Labels of the comparisons, `"a-b"`: the group labels when given, otherwise the positions of the samples in the
list (from 1). Groups without data are left out, as in R.

TukeyHSDResult.pAdj#summary.en: p-values adjusted for the multiple comparisons.

TukeyHSDResult.warnings#summary.en: R's warnings, each once, in R's order (an empty array when there are none).

dscfAllPairsTest#summary.en:
Dwass-Steel-Critchlow-Fligner all-pairs test of pairwise Mann-Whitney statistics. Equivalent to
`PMCMRplus::dscfAllPairsTest()` in R. The statistic, sqrt(2) (U - n_i n_j / 2) / sqrt(Var U) with the smaller U,
is never positive.

dunnTest#summary.en:
Dunn's test of all pairs of mean ranks. Equivalent to `dunn.test::dunn.test(x, g, method, altp)` in R. The step-wise
adjustments multiply (or transform) each p-value by the factor of its rank and cap it at 1, without enforcing
monotonicity, as dunn.test does (unlike `pAdjust`). Equal p-values share the rank of the first of them in the
ordering, so they get the same adjusted value (dunn.test ranks ties in the order of the comparisons).

dunnettTest#summary.en:
Dunnett's many-to-one test of means against the control (the first group), with the pooled variance. Equivalent to
`PMCMRplus::dunnettTest()` in R. The p-values are the exact multivariate t probabilities (R approximates them by
randomised integration); two-sided, as in PMCMRplus, `min(1, 2 P(max T_i >= |t|))`.

gamesHowellTest#summary.en:
Games-Howell all-pairs test of means with Welch's standard errors and degrees of freedom. Equivalent to
`PMCMRplus::gamesHowellTest()` in R.

glhtDunnett#summary.en:
Dunnett's many-to-one comparisons of a one-way ANOVA with simultaneous p-values. Equivalent to
`multcomp::glht()` in R. It gives `summary(glht(aov(y ~ g), linfct = mcp(g = "Dunnett"), alternative))`, with the
exact multivariate t probabilities (R approximates them by randomised integration): two-sided
`P(max |T_i| >= |t|)`, greater `P(max T_i >= t)`, less `P(min T_i <= t)`.

kwAllPairsDunnTest#@param g.en: Group labels, parallel to `x` (groups in the order of the sorted labels).

kwAllPairsDunnTest#summary.en: Dunn's all-pairs test of mean ranks with adjusted p-values. Equivalent to `PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest()` in R.

kwManyOneDunnTest#summary.en:
Dunn's many-to-one test of mean ranks against the control (the first group). Equivalent to
`PMCMRplus::kwManyOneDunnTest()` in R. With `pAdjustMethod` `"single-step"` (the default) the p-values are the
exact simultaneous normal probabilities (R approximates them by randomised integration).

manyOneUTest#@param g.en: Group labels, parallel to `x` (groups in the order of the sorted labels).

manyOneUTest#summary.en:
Steel's many-to-one rank test in its normal approximation: the Mann-Whitney statistic of each group against the
control (the first group), each pair ranked on its own (midranks), standardised with the tie-corrected variance.
Equivalent to `PMCMRplus::manyOneUTest()` in R. The statistic is positive when the group ranks higher than the
control. With `pAdjustMethod` `"single-step"` (the default; at least three groups) the p-values are the exact
simultaneous normal probabilities (R approximates them by randomised integration).

pAdjust#@param options.en: See {@link PAdjustOptions}, or just the method name as a string.

pAdjust#@returns.en: Adjusted p-values, in the same order as `p`.

pAdjust#summary.en:
Adjusts p-values for multiple comparisons. Equivalent to R's `p.adjust()`.

`NaN` values are excluded from the adjustment and returned as `NaN` in place. If `n` is
1 or less, the p-values are returned unchanged. Differences from R: with `"hommel"` a
non-integer `n` or an `n` above 65536 (O(n^2) work, about 6 s at the limit) is an error, and an empty `p` always
gives an empty result.

pairwisePropTest#@param n.en:
Numbers of trials per group. Groups with `NaN` in `x` or `n` are dropped (the rows and columns are then
  numbered over the groups kept, as in R).

pairwisePropTest#summary.en: Pairwise two-group tests of equal proportions, with adjusted p-values. Equivalent to R's `pairwise.prop.test()`.

pairwiseTTest#summary.en: Pairwise t tests between groups, with adjusted p-values. Equivalent to R's `pairwise.t.test()`.

pairwiseWilcoxTest#summary.en:
Pairwise Wilcoxon rank sum (or signed rank, with `paired`) tests between groups, with adjusted p-values. Equivalent
to R's `pairwise.wilcox.test()`. `method` is that of the last comparison, as in R.

tukeyTest#summary.en: Tukey's all-pairs test of means (Tukey-Kramer for unequal sizes). Equivalent to `PMCMRplus::tukeyTest()` in R.
